_readme: Config for the contract_br provisioning depth: which BR rule-value-mapping bodies to
create so a CONTRACT (rather than an apiKey) drives the markup rules.
This file is empty on purpose. Everything SMF does with BR today is apiKey-shaped
contract equivalent is not known yet. Until an env below is filled in, creating a
contract_br scenario still builds the mocks and the contract, and reports the BR step
as NOT_CONFIGURED rather than pretending it succeeded.
To enable, add an entry per env. Each item is POSTed to /rulevaluemappings verbatim,
except inputValue, which SMF fills from the created contract:
contract_value_field : which contract attribute becomes inputValue —
conditions           : raw rule-value-mapping bodies. Copy the shape from
br_child_conditions.json; set inputDetailId to whatever the
BR service uses for a contract input.
